name: Webform Eloqua
description: Webform handler that posts submissions to Oracle Eloqua via the Eloqua API Redux service.
project_description: Webform Eloqua adds a single Webform handler plugin (id 'webform_eloqua', label 'Eloqua') that maps Webform elements to Eloqua form fields and posts completed submissions to an Oracle Eloqua form via the eloqua_api_redux 'eloqua_api_redux.forms' service. The connection, authentication and HTTP transport are entirely delegated to the Eloqua API Redux module; this module contributes only the handler, its per-form configuration UI (Eloqua form selection plus a webform_mapping widget), required-field validation, and the postSave -> remotePost flow that fires on STATE_COMPLETED. Requires Webform and Eloqua API Redux.
